authority: Bounded reference-refresh delta review and existing isolated fixture tests
reviewedBehavior: Patch-kit check runs before member work; missing or unavailable patches downgrade deep members to structural builds.

Only members still planned for deep builds probe cooldown. Configured OpenAI-compatible providers receive a one-token request; HTTP 429 downgrades to structural, while missing settings, other responses and transport failure allow the ordinary deep attempt.
Cooldown detail derives from status, configured model/base URL, Retry-After and current time. Response bodies are not read by this probe.
Git probes separate stdout for parsing from stderr for failure detail. Missing Git metadata, dirty members and off-main members remain distinct from successful pull/build.
Build failure takes precedence over downgrade reporting; deep coverage is retained only for successful deep builds.
Reports add optional preflight and detail keys, preserving decoding of older receipts. Bounded tail capture does not itself redact arbitrary subprocess output.
Rendered timer service orders after the deep-refresh service without adding a requirement dependency. This review tests rendered text, not live systemd serialization.
semanticInputs: Manifest, selected root, member Git metadata, branch cleanliness, upstream refs and network availability
Installed Graft binary and patch kit, PATH, HOME, package-root override and provider configuration
Provider response status and headers, current clock, deadlines and jobs count
Existing filesystem and environment inherited by deep builds, notifier and systemctl
effects: Production refresh can fetch upstream changes, update Git excludes, rebuild structural/deep indexes, make provider requests, write local status and notify the operator.
These tests use temporary fixtures, scripted executables and scripted HTTP responses; they do not run a real reference refresh or install timers.

verification.command: bun --no-env-file run --cwd packages/tooling/tool/cli beep:test test/refs-refresh-plan.test.ts test/refs-schemas.test.ts test/refs-timer.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

limits: No claim of live provider behavior, quota availability, installed patch correctness or timer runtime ordering.
Configured URLs/models and arbitrary failing subprocess tails still require sanitization before publication; truncation is only a size bound.
Ambient filesystem and provider state are not immutable inputs, and replay cannot reproduce maintenance effects or fresh external verdicts.
This review does not qualify task-result reuse, replace signed conformance evidence or mutate a policy tuple.
